description: A change asked in words on ONE generated page (agentMaterializeL2 pages50), applied as a patch of its .ts and recorded in the history of its .defs.ts so a regeneration redoes it. Presentation only: anything the shared does not already offer is refused. Documentation only: agents are found by convention (agent*.ts with createAgent).
entry: { module, page, device?: 'desktop'|'mobile', genome?: 'page11', request, operations? } (JSON, from aura/plugins/selectPage)

phases.plan: no operations: the gate step runs; refused = failed step with the reason; approved = completed step with traceMsg PLAN:<operations json>. Nothing is written.
phases.apply: operations approved by the person: the patch step runs directly (the gate does not run twice).

steps.goal: deterministic bootstrap (skipRootLLM); adds the gate or the patch step
verdict apply|refuse + operations { organism|null, aspect, change (English), summary (person's language), revert }

complete methods + new catalogue keys; guards and splice (editPageCore); write model + local copy; compile; attempt 2 = one repair; failure puts the .ts back. Success: history + trace, traceMsg NOTES:{notes, history, warnings}

writes.page: _<project>_/l2/<module>/web/<device>/<genome>/<page>.ts — model + local copy, like a Studio edit (saved by the person)
writes.history: the same folder's <page>.defs.ts, export history: one kind 'request' entry per operation, key organism + aspect (target), last one wins; a revert removes it. Only in the projects of DEFS_HISTORY_PROJECTS (aura/studio/studioDefsHistory.ts)
writes.trace: _<project>_/l2/<module>/pipeline/agentEditPage/<page><Device>[<Genome>]<stamp>.json — request, operations, touched methods, new keys, notes, history result, the file before and after
